answer: A concrete approach: bind a hardware-attested enclave quote to the identity key at join time. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the bond burns and standing resets to zero. The network ties the falcon to sunk effort, uses the mesa as an corroborating signal, then requires a violet before any payout.
